subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Numbers deserve respect, but not blind trust.”?
options: At night, even familiar things can make people ask new questions.
Information can change behavior when it is clear, personal, and connected to choices people can actually make.
Before using data to make decisions, people must check how the data was collected.
Sometimes it takes visitors to make people notice what they already have.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「At night, even familiar things can make people ask new questions.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Information can change behavior when it is clear, personal, and connected to choices people can actually make.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Numbers deserve respect, but not blind trust. Before using data to make decisions, people must check how the data was collected.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
